name: Hamden's Summer Day Camps
description_short: Town of Hamden two-week day camps, 8:30am-3pm: Munchkins (age 3 1/2 to kindergarten) and Rascal (grades 1-2) at Shepherd Glen, Green Dragons (grades 3-5) and Gold Dragons (grades 6-7) at Hamden High, and Camp Brooksvale (ages 6-14, 9am-3pm) with nature programs and barnyard animals at Brooksvale Park. Field trips, arts and crafts, games and theme days. Resident rates; non-resident rates on request.

warnings: The only season shown is Summer 2026, and it is already over (today is 2026-10-13). No 2027 information has been posted yet.
This page is just an index. The camp details (dates, prices, ages, locations) are in linked PDFs that were not part of this source.
The address given is the Hamden Government Center, which is the Recreation Department's office. The camps may be held somewhere else.
There are several camps, not just one. Each one may need its own listing once the camp grid PDF has been read.

open_questions: This is five town camps at three sites (Shepherd Glen, Hamden High, Brooksvale Park) under one listing, with the town hall as the address. Keep one umbrella listing, or split Camp Brooksvale (a nature and farm camp at Brooksvale Park) into its own listing?
Prices are resident rates; non-resident rates are 'available upon request'. OK to publish resident rates with that note in the description?

swim_waterfront_notes: Rascal Camp (grades 1-2) may swim, optionally, twice a week at the Hamden High School pool. Send a flotation device with non-swimmers.
special_needs_notes: Munchkins Camp campers must be toilet trained.
